roles.dev: Developer role - code, docs, commits, pushes
roles.agent: Agent engineer - new nodes, state schema
roles.release: Release manager - milestone verification, tag pushes

prdlb: PRD rules enforcer — minimal dependencies only, KISS, no over-engineering, no extra design patterns without justification doc
kisstb: KISS checker — every node stays simple, no abstraction layers
isoltb: Isolation guard — TeamState isolation, supervisor routing only, no subgraph leaks
duratb: Durability verifier — PostgresSaver session persistence, resumable execution
contb: Container guard — Docker-compose single command, no extra services
failtb: Failure isolation — single agent failure never crashes workflow
